memories.title: Absolute positioning owned by toolkit
memories.context: Original implementation had UI calculating room offsets. Different clients could calculate differently.
options: Toolkit owns positioning with absolute coords
memories.chosen: Toolkit owns positioning with absolute coords
memories.reasoning: Toolkit owns all rules including spatial. API stores what toolkit provides. Client renders directly. No math duplication.
consequences: Rooms have absolute offsets in dungeon-space
API stores and returns absolute coords

memories.title: Cube coordinates for hex grids
memories.context: Hex grids need a coordinate system. Multiple options exist.
memories.reasoning: No ambiguity, clean math, constraint q+r+s=0 catches errors. Industry standard for hex grids.
consequences: All positions use (q, r, s) tuples
